notes.title: More Cowboys | More Chaos
notes.notes:
Howdy partners, hope you are having a great new year, 2020 is upon us!

We have added an additional 10 box cars to our Wild West Steam Train! In addition players will no longer experience wait times as they join as non full games will let you spawn instantly on the train.  We added this feature to speed up the carnage and chaos and make sure players have as little down time as possible and more time in the world exploring.

We are still working on several other bugs and are very grateful for all the feedback and comments contributed to our project.  Thank you all very much for playing and taking aim at being Best in the West.

[b]All Aboard!!![/b]

Warm regards,
Curtis Ashford

notes.title: Hot Fix
notes.notes:
The launch was an exciting time but it really exposed our game breaking flaws that we had not properly fixed.

I am very grateful for everyone that has helped out and apologize to those that had a frustrating negative experience when trying to que for a game.

The train has been fixed so players no longer die before the game begins.

The game has been fixed so players will only join into games that have NOT started.

Player speed has been slightly reduced.

Text chat has been relocated to be less intrusive.

*note*
We are working very hard on getting a new UI / HUD out ASAP

Have fun and thank you for your patience.
